name: Natural History Museum (Mauritius Institute)
subtitle: The oldest museum in Mauritius, housed in the Mauritius Institute building.

facts.label: Opening
facts.value: Desjardins Museum opened to the public on 14 October 1842.

facts.label: Move
facts.value: In 1885 the collection moved to the new Mauritius Institute building.

facts.label: Dodo
facts.value: Dodo model is the centrepiece; the skeleton on display was collected in 1900, all bones from one bird.

parts.text: The oldest museum in Mauritius, housed in the Mauritius Institute building. It shows 500 years of the island's natural history, with a dodo model as centrepiece. Status of reopening after the 2017 closure was not confirmed.
